notes: The creator scripts build the Huppermage with Actor.changeSkin for the base skin and Actor.equip for custom hair/clothes/equipment visuals.
Hair visuals follow the script formula 20 + breed(2 digits) + sex + 000 + hairIndex.
Clothes visuals follow the script formula 21 + breed(2 digits) + sex + 0100 in the creator scripts.
This file stores relations verified from local game files only. It does not guess draw order or final bone transforms.
